description: Valuation, preparation, marketing, negotiation and support through to signing.

items.text: Service
Valuation, preparation, marketing, negotiation and support through to signing.
Selling a property is not just about listing it.

As property consultants, we first tell you honestly whether selling makes sense for you, how to do it, and when. Then we study the property and its documentation in depth, so there are no surprises at signing.
Everything starts with a [valuation report](service:valoracion): the market value, the recommended asking price, and the strategy to get there.
How we do it
Eight steps, one advisor

items.title: Valuation
items.text: We study the property, the neighbourhood and the market to set a fair and competitive price.

items.title: Preparation
items.text: We gather and review all the documentation needed for the sale.

items.title: Listing
items.text: We present the property on our website and the main property portals.

items.title: Follow-up
items.text: Every two weeks we update you on activity and how the market is responding.

items.title: Viewings
items.text: We organise and accompany viewings with genuinely interested buyers.

items.title: Negotiation
items.text: We negotiate on your behalf. The decision to accept an offer is always yours.

items.title: Signing
items.text: We review the closing documentation and accompany you to the notary.

items.title: After the sale
items.text: We transfer utility contracts and handle the payment of sale taxes.
What's included
Everything it takes to sell
What our brokerage service includes in a sale.

items.title: Updated valuation
items.text: Market value and recommended asking price, with a comparable sales study.

items.title: Market read
items.text: How demand looks in your area and what to expect over the coming months.

items.title: Marketing and advertising
items.text: Listings on property portals, our website and other channels.

items.title: Professional photography and virtual tour
items.text: A professional photographer and a virtual walkthrough that filters out casual visitors.

items.title: Technical documentation
items.text: Our architect handles the habitation certificate and energy certificate, and draws up the floor plan.

items.title: Renovation estimates
items.text: If the property needs work, the buyer knows the cost from the start.

items.title: Viewings management
items.text: We organise and supervise them.

items.title: Negotiation and closing
items.text: We defend your price and your conditions through to signing.

items.title: Legal and tax advice
items.text: Every step of the sale reviewed legally and fiscally by specialists. [See legal and tax advice](service:asesoramiento-juridico-fiscal).

items.title: Buyer financing
items.text: Our financial broker checks the buyer can pay, so the sale doesn't fall through on the mortgage.

items.title: Property clearance
items.text: We help you plan and organise the clearance before handover.

items.title: Utilities and taxes
items.text: After signing, transfer of electricity, water and gas contracts, and settlement of sale taxes.
Brokerage agreement
Why exclusive?
No race between agencies

When several agencies sell the same property, the sale turns into a race to close it first. Work gets rushed: speed takes priority and the quality of the deal and the sale price fall by the wayside. With exclusivity, we work your property carefully and with criteria, to sell it well and at the price it deserves.
What you gain
Full dedication to your property throughout the contract.
More considered marketing, because only one agency presents it.
A stronger negotiation: we know your property inside out.
More security: no one else negotiates on your behalf.
Less complication and clear communication with buyers.
"Don't worry, I'll take care of it."

Many sales fall through over an unexpected issue: a missing habitation certificate, a mortgage that doesn't come through, incomplete documentation. We anticipate them and, when they appear, we resolve them.
